title: Apiary Steward
setting: A single apiary started by a beekeeper who has died, now tended by a neighbor, a teen apprentice, and the beekeeper's adult child who lives two towns over. A new varroa treatment requires dismantling the original hive boxes. The bees have started building comb in the lid.

characters.name: Inspector
characters.tendencies: Logs frame counts and mite drops. Counts bees the way you'd count cells.

characters.name: Steward
characters.tendencies: Does the actual hive work. Knows the smell of each box. Distrusts new treatments.

characters.name: Voice
characters.tendencies: The beekeeper's child. Answers questions from the food co-op. Carries the founder's cadence.

characters.name: Apprentice
characters.tendencies: Has started naming the queens. Trusts the colony, not the schedule.
